name: Furrykids Safehaven (FKSH)
legalName: Persatuan Penyelamat Haiwan Terbiar Furrykids Safehaven
summary: Rescue, rehabilitate and give a second chance to stray dogs facing culling or abandonment.
programmes: Dog rescue (incl. Mission Pawsible response to Negeri Sembilan culling)
impact: Over 2,000 dogs sheltered (site; also Malaysiakini, March 2025)
beneficiaries: Stray and rescued dogs, mainly from the Klang Valley and Negeri Sembilan

organisation.founders: Founded by a small group of individuals after DBKL put 84 dogs on death row (names not published)

live.note: YouTube and TikTok accounts linked from site; activity not checked. https://www.tiktok.com/@furrykidssafehaven

donationsToday: SenangPay online (one-off or monthly, RM10-RM1,000 or any amount), direct bank transfer, item sponsorship by email; PayPal not accepted
